description: The Iran Traffic Sign Dataset compiles street-view images recorded across Iranian cities and roads during 2023–2024. Its Figshare item description gives 14,111 images with 19,718 labelled sign instances in 118 classes, covering seasons, lighting and viewing angles. The article rounds the instance total to about 19,000. The repository lists an image-and-label RAR archive and a companion ZIP, and states CC BY 4.0. The producer describes Pascal VOC XML and YOLO text annotations made with MakeSense. Coverage is a selected collection of visible road signs, not an audited inventory of every installed sign or a live asset feed. Camera choice, geographic sampling, class balance and image-only capture are limitations for inferring sign condition or national coverage. A reviewer-assessed use is testing detection before constructing visual road-asset states in a transport digital twin. No close existing traffic-sign image record was found for a related identifier; traffic-signal control benchmarks concern a different resource type. The named Figshare API opened, while the human landing returned HTTP 202 without content. No image archive, annotation or trained model was downloaded or examined.
